fr_html: Le PRESIDENT rappelle qu'on va continuer la discussion ouverte la veille sur la question des incompatibilités.
en_html: The PRESIDENT reminded the Committee that the discussion of the question of incompatibility, which had been commenced on the previous day, was to be continued.
